intro.text: A soldier in Kaladin's squad in Amaram's army.

items.text: In the battle against Hallaw, Reesh shouted at Kaladin to stop before he attacked an enemy Shardbearer, but Kaladin did not listen. Afterwards Reesh was executed by Amaram, along with Hab, Alabet and Coreb, once Kaladin had given Coreb the Shardblade.
